title: Kestrel Delivery Plan Terms: Enrollment, Delivery Address and Change of Plan (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
## Terms of enrollment

1. **Age.** The patient enrolling in a Delivery & Pickup Services plan must be at least the plan's minimum age, in whole years, on the enrollment date.
2. **Delivery address.** For a courier plan the delivery address must lie within the plan's largest delivery distance of the fulfilling store; a mail plan delivers to any US address. The delivery address is recorded exactly as the patient states it.
3. **Specialty courier.** Kestrel Specialty Courier Service is enrolled only for a patient with a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription in received or active status.
4. **Change of plan.** A plan switch is an update of the same plan, allowed only where the current plan allows switching and the plan is in enrolled or active status. A switch to a subscription plan starts that plan's billing on the switch date with no new trial when the patient has had a trial before, and a switch from Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual refunds its subscription fee under the subscription fee refund terms as a cancellation would.

The minimum age, the largest delivery distance and whether switching is allowed are the plan's own figures in the Delivery & Pickup Services plan terms and service area schedule.

## The specialty prescription condition

The condition in term 3 is read from the patient's prescription records, not from the patient's description of their therapy. It is met when a prescription on the same patient's profile has the handling class Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription and its status is received or active, at the time of enrollment.

| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription on the patient's profile | Kestrel Specialty Courier Service may be enrolled |
|---|---|
| in received status | yes |
| in active status | yes |
| in any other status, or none held | no |
| held only by another patient (for example a family member) | no |

## Change of plan at a glance

| Current plan's status | Current plan allows switching | Switch |
|---|---|---|
| enrolled or active | yes | allowed, as an update of the same plan |
| enrolled or active | no | not allowed |
| past due or cancelled | either | not allowed |

## Hypothetical cases

- A patient who turns 18 on the enrollment date meets an 18-year minimum on that date; a patient who turns 18 the day after does not.
- A patient on Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly, who had its free trial when first enrolling, switches to Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass: the Senior pass's billing starts on the switch date and no new trial is given.
- A patient whose plan is past due asks to change plan: a switch is allowed only from enrolled or active status, so the switch is not made while the plan is past due.
